items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Another good pianist was a pianist that was with Chick Webb, Kirk Patrick and Joe Steele. Joe Steele had an arrangement on 'Coalyard Shuffle' was the darnedest thing you ever heard. They were all good piano players.

ctx.x: I forgot to ask you yesterday when you were doing those rent parties, you were very young, did you run into Fats Waller and James P. Johnson at those?

Oh yeah, oh yeah. James P. Of course as you see I've made records with James P. I never made any, didn't make any records with Fats. But oh yeah, Fats Waller, they used to have those sessions, they used to be an after hour place there on 132nd Street and everybody used to go there and have those piano jam sessions and Willie the Lion Smith used to come in smoking his cigar, he was very braggadocious like, he'd just walk in you know and somebody's sit down there at the piano and he would walk in and everybody…
And they would all make those sessions.
